description: Salesforce is a cloud CRM platform for managing sales, service, and marketing data, with a broad set of APIs for reading and writing org data.
access_notes: A free Developer Edition org (developer.salesforce.com/signup) gives immediate REST/SOAP/Bulk API access for building and testing, no approval needed. Caveat: for an existing production org, API access depends on the org's purchased edition (e.g. some lower editions require an add-on for API access) -- this is an org-level licensing detail, not a Composio integration blocker, since Developer Edition itself is unrestricted.
api_notes: REST API is the primary surface; OTHER covers SOAP API, Bulk API, Streaming/Pub-Sub API, Metadata API and Tooling API, which together reach essentially the full CRM object model (records, custom objects, Apex actions, Flows). Correction from an earlier draft that mis-tagged this as SDK_ONLY -- client libraries are convenience wrappers, not a separate access surface.
